args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

src/money.py quantized the cent rounding with ROUND_HALF_UP, but
FIN-212 specifies banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This matches
the documented behavior of round_money and fixes the failing tests
in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` rounded to cents using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 (and `round_money`'s own docstring) specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (previously failing `tests/test_money.py` now green).
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")` and `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding at the half-cent).

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py` quantized to cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while the docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), which is what `tests/test_money.py` asserts.
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` and changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- **CI:** Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch — it **passed**.
- **PR:** Opened [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` with alex requested as reviewer.

Per policy I didn't merge into main; it awaits alex's code-owner review.

transcript.reasoning_content:
The bug: uses ROUND_HALF_UP instead of ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Fix on branch, commit, trigger CI, wait, open PR with alex reviewer.

Note test expects 2.675 → 2.68, which is ROUND_HALF_EVEN? 2.675 quantized to 2 decimals: half case, banker's rounding goes to even → 2.68 (since 7 is odd, round up to 8). 2.665 → 2.66 (6 is even). Yes, ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Create branch, commit fix.
